simple.summary: מַלְבֵּן (malbên) means a brickkiln First listed occurrence: 2Sam 12 31.

definitions.full: H4404. malben מַלְבֵּן noun [masculine] 1 brick-mould ; 2 quadrangle (on meaning brick-mould , and figurative something rectangular , see Hoffm ZAW 1882, 53-72 Dr 2Sam 12:31 , compare Late Hebrew מַלְבֵּן ; Arabic ; Syriac ); — 1 brick-mould , 2Sam 12:31 Qr (Kt, by error, מלכן ), Nahum 3:14 . 2 quadrangle , Jer 43:9 (at Tahpanhes).
